notes.title: DevSpeaks #2: Villagers
notes.content:
It's been a long time since last time you heard from us. Right now we're on our way to the first demo. It takes a while but we sure we can bring some gameplay quite soon. And now, our team wants to share some new models that were made for out projects.

[b]Peasants[/b]

In Brave Tales you home and game hub is a small Slavic village in the middle of nowhere. There are some villagers who can ask you for help sometimes. But they are divided by class distinctions between each other. There are nobles who live in a cottages and have a peasants, who work for them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/3d395e24ff2ed6e8e1a58e6403b7c752f98dc5f3.jpg[/img]

They have no rights, no luxury houses. All peasants live in a huts and are struggling to get on their feet. Their only hope is praying.

This are the first two models of a male and female peasant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/ed8fd5161f83ecf11ccf55b2f1be03b53a094a9f.jpg[/img]

[b]Nobles[/b]

The nobles are the people who treat peasant as slaves and force them to do hard work. They usually wear expensive clothes and live in luxury. Nobles are fastidious, so, their requests would be hard and picky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/6e5236592c62e262e7855ebe1c772df3d9825752.jpg[/img]

Unlike the females, who were housewives in the majority, the men live an idle live. They demand more, gain more and do nothing for that. All the work is delegated to peasants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/c69de0450a13bf3f83769ffd21a9ae97758648cb.jpg[/img]
The only thing that unite peasants and nobles is religion.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]All team of hrzn. Studios Inc. wish you a Happy Holidays! See you in 2022! Stay safe![/b]

notes.title: DevSpeaks #1: Modeling of the Hub - Part One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/3996071aa5fb217291c89d67315c0f7aa6fb5961.jpg[/img]

There were several weeks after our first showcase. We gained a lot of feedback about our prototype and went back to make significant changes. Since then, our team is ready to show you some pieces of our work.

For now, we're still in an early stages of development.

[b]Blacksmith house[/b]

One of the main characters who you can meet in the village is blacksmith. Your hero can buy new weapons and upgrade them. He's very generous man, so behave well and you will get a good price, but if he'll lose his temper prices will go significantly up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/2a66c84d4205be968174892867ecea8d93e710e6.gif[/img]

This is his house in a modeling production. He'll be ready soon.

[b]Healer's house[/b]

Ready as the other one is house of a healer. He lives nearby, so you cannot lose you way in the woods. Once your hero is struggling with his abilities or magic the healer's potions is the right choice. Healer crafts potions for about 20 years, so he's a master. Also, he is a bit messy, a lot of things are just laying around the house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41166227/5b7ddddb723680ad6a3077464aa2433f78fc0fa3.gif[/img]

His house is in production right now too.
